title: National Cyber Security Centre Research & Innovation Priorities
summary: Ireland's National Cyber Security Centre sets out research and innovation priorities, stating that the global shift to post-quantum cryptography is already underway and that Ireland must ensure a secure transition for Government, regulated sectors and critical infrastructure.

title: Opening Statement by Richard Browne, Director of the National Cyber Security Centre, to the Joint Committee on Foreign Affairs and Defence
summary: Opening statement by the Director of Ireland's National Cyber Security Centre to an Oireachtas joint committee, which references the challenges associated with the shift to post-quantum computing alongside other cyber threats.

title: National Cyber Security Strategy Draft for Public Consultation 2026
issuingOrg: Department of Justice, Home Affairs and Migration
summary: Draft national cyber security strategy for public consultation, prepared by the Department of Justice, Home Affairs and Migration. Measure 2.1.4 commits Government Departments to agreeing a national roadmap for the transition to post-quantum cryptography, and the draft states that a PQC working group will be established.

title: Research Ireland Public Service Fellowship 2026: Cyber Security Research - Post Quantum Cryptography
summary: Research Ireland Public Service Fellowship 2026 project description in which the National Cyber Security Centre invites research on secure communications in a post-quantum era, including the impact of quantum computing on encryption standards and quantum-safe cryptographic methods for national security applications.
